Digital marketing

Planning a content marketing strategy

A worthwhile content plan begins with the questions people ask before they buy. Use those questions to decide what deserves writing and where readers should go next.

In this guide
Collect buying questionsChoose the right formatReview what happens next

Collect buying questions

Ask sales and support to bring ten questions from recent conversations. Group them by decision, such as choosing a material, comparing services or understanding installation. Mark which questions currently have a useful answer on the website.

Choose the right format

A service page suits someone ready to enquire. A comparison or illustrated guide can help a reader still weighing options. Give each piece one main question, an intended reader and a natural next step.

Review what happens next

Link the guide to the relevant service. Look at the queries bringing readers in, the enquiries that follow and the questions customers still ask. Use those findings to decide what to revise before adding another article.
